fma_contraction_policy: OFF: -ffp-contract=off (GCC default for GNU C++ is 'fast'); products and sums are rounded separately so FIR accumulation reproduces the numpy pairwise order
denormal_policy: none (no FTZ/DAZ; bit-identity with the reference; all filters are feed-forward so denormals cannot self-sustain)
platforms_compiled_and_tested: Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu 24.04, GCC 13.3.0, Ninja, CMake 3.28.3) — compiled, self-tested, validated, benchmarked
platforms_not_compiled: Windows x86_64 (intended deployment target): no Windows toolchain or cross-compiler in this container — NOT RUN; MSVC flags in native/CMakeLists.txt are untested
isa: generic x86-64 (no -march flag); SMLSP3000_NATIVE_ARCH=OFF; AVX2/AVX-512 not required
dependencies: none beyond the C++20 standard library; no paid/proprietary dependencies; no licence accepted
